groups.title: 1 · Opening
groups.heading: An invitation, sooner.
groups.description: Compare only the opening hierarchy. Keep the signature, artwork, translation and English quotation. On phones, A and B put the reading button before the image.
variants: B · Give the quotation its own pause
checks: Use 360px to compare when Read this issue becomes visible.
A keeps a quieter quotation in the opening; B moves it below the featured poems.
The artwork and Odia signature stay unchanged.

groups.title: 2 · Poem excerpts
groups.heading: Enough words to invite you in.
groups.description: Compare original-language excerpts from the same three poems. No poem is rewritten.
checks: A extends each excerpt to four lines, preserving stanza breaks.
B keeps a short image for Odia and English, and the closing thought for Hindi.
Judge the words, then their visual rhythm across three scripts.

groups.title: 3 · Poet presence
groups.heading: Meet the person in the poem.
groups.description: Compare the repeated poet strip with portraits inside the poem cards, or a separate spotlight on a different poet.
variants: B · A different poet in the spotlight
checks: A removes the repeated strip and adds a small portrait beside each byline.
B retains text bylines and introduces Pravakar Satapathy below the poems.
The spotlight uses his own exact poem excerpt and actual contribution count.

groups.title: 4 · Recent editions
groups.heading: A lighter shelf of editions.
groups.description: Desktop keeps three covers. The alternatives change only the phone layout and the amount of cover-story detail on the homepage.
variants: A · One cover, two compact entries — recommended
checks: Switch to 360px; the current three full covers require considerable scrolling.
Full cover art and cultural stories remain on the edition pages.
A preserves one large current cover; B treats all three editions equally.

groups.title: 5 · Page rhythm
groups.heading: Room to breathe, less distance to travel.
groups.description: Compare section spacing across the complete homepage. Typography, content and reading line height are preserved.
checks: Current section padding is 54px above and below. A uses 36px desktop / 28px phone; B uses 28px / 20px.
Read through the preview to compare transitions.
This does not apply the separate poem or poet recommendations.

groups.title: 6 · Editors & footer
groups.heading: The people, simply introduced.
groups.description: Current retains portraits, roles and short descriptions. A makes the editor introduction more compact. B lets an editorial quotation lead into it. The footer stays as approved.
checks: Current is a valid choice: I recommend retaining these brief introductions unless you prefer a shorter page.
A removes only the short descriptive sentences.
B relocates the existing English quotation here; it does not duplicate it.

groups.title: 7 · Journal introduction
groups.heading: Make the welcome clear.
groups.description: Compare where to explain that Kabita Live is a monthly multilingual poetry journal. This replaces existing metadata rather than adding another section.
checks: A: A monthly journal of Odia, Hindi and English poetry.
B: Monthly poetry · Odia, Hindi & English.
Both integrate the 16-poem count into the issue line, preserving the useful fact.

groups.title: 8 · Reading links
groups.heading: Easy to notice. Easy to touch.
groups.description: Compare the present links with larger touch areas. These changes are scoped to homepage content links.
variants: A · Quiet underlines, generous targets — recommended
checks: A preserves Read the poem and quietly adds space around the author link.
B uses Read ଦୋକାନ, Read क्षणिका and Read Drink to make each destination explicit.
Both target at least 44px for byline and reading links; normal font sizes remain.

groups.title: 9 · Image loading
groups.heading: The same portraits, a lighter page.
groups.description: This is a delivery choice, not a new art direction. All previews use the existing images. The two editor originals total about 790KB; smaller derivatives will be produced only when the delivery approach is implemented.
checks: Appearance stays the same. There is no simulated speed claim in this preview.
A serves smaller files for standard-density screens and sharper ones for high-density screens.
B uses one sharper file everywhere. Original masters are preserved in either option.
